title: Joint Business Holders: Legal Requirements and Documentation
summary: Explains joint business account holder requirements: up to 4 joint business account holders, governance documents must authorize multiple holders and reflect current officers/managers. Requires formation/registration docs, a resolution naming authorized individuals, ID + beneficial ownership materials, and matching tax ID and business contact details.
faqs: How many joint business account holders can a business designate?

What documents are required for onboarding joint business holders (resolution, IDs, beneficial ownership, formation/registration)?
What happens if the dual-authorization control is applied to my account—who must approve transactions?
What submission tips help avoid delays when names or governance documents don’t match state/country records?
What should we retain for audits and compliance reviews?
